name: Progressive disclosure
rule: Lead with what most people need and tuck optional or advanced content behind a clear control.

leaders.note: Conditional form fields appear only when an earlier answer makes them relevant, which keeps the form short and focused.
Collapsibles hold optional material such as advanced settings. They start closed, essential content stays visible, and urgent or destructive actions stay out.
A compact icon trigger opens a temporary menu, so secondary actions stay out of the main view until someone asks for them.
